A 44-tonne freight lorry crashes and capsizes in the middle of the M6, an HGV almost catches fire when its brakes lock on, and a school bus breaks down in a dangerous spot.

PC Andy Doran is at the scene of a collision on the A6, where a young driver has fallen asleep at the wheel and crashed into a lamp post. On the edge of the Peak District, PC Amy Hollis is on scene where a car has come off the road and hit a bridge.
Rookie interceptor Rachael faces a baptism of fire including a chase with a pregnant passenger, and a deluded motorist calls the police to report interceptor Chris for stealing his car.
A failure to stop turns into a full-blown kidnapping situation. Liam and the team make a shocking discovery when a 14-year-old lad is found in possession of a bag of crack cocaine, cash and a knife.

PCs Matt Turner and Ian Cosgrove head to the scene of a collision in Middlewich, where an 11-year-old child has been hit by a van. On the M56, PC Rowan Burt is searching for a driver wanted for unpaid speeding fines.
Police pursue a smoking Audi A3 that fails to stop, before the wannabe Mario hurls cans of oil at the cops. And a suspected drink driver literally gatecrashes a holiday park.
A car linked to organised crime is hunted down and stopped in dramatic fashion, police intervene in a family dispute, and a hooded man is behaving threateningly towards young women.
Mulder and Scully try to explain their roles in a twisted killing that occurred while they were investigating a case in Texas.

Mother of two Joanne Dennehy launched a knife attack on a man she had lured back to her flat before stabbing two men out walking their dogs. Now locked behind bars, Dennehy is one of only three women currently serving a whole life order in the UK.
Steve Graham is racing the rain and joining forces to build a mega road train. Meanwhile, on a cross-country marathon, Yogi's truck hits the wall.
In Manchester, Sam aka Hiab princess must deliver three huge shipping containers to a remote farm. Meanwhile, in Birmingham, Mark's in charge of moving a 57-foot-long canal boat to a marina.

A 36-tonne crusher that's been out on hire at a quarry in Anglesey needs collecting and delivering to a depot in Liverpool. Caravan haulage hero Ewan takes a holiday home 320 miles from Hull to the Isle of Arran off the Scottish west coast.
